note: Single source of truth for Archive verdict cards. Rendered by apps/pages/src/pages/Archive.tsx (#/archive) and by scripts/build_pages.py (docs/methods/index.html#archive + docs/methods/justina_round1_scoreboard.html). Numbers copied verbatim from repo artifacts / PR bodies; do not re-round. Sharpe cells show the excess-of-BIL Sharpe (headline) with the legacy rf = 0 Sharpe (CAGR / vol, the figure the archived verdicts were judged on) in parentheses; excess figures come from data/processed/cash_null_audit/site_sharpe.json (tests/test_gate_metrics.py checks them). Optional link fields: nw_t_links[] and measured{label,text}; hrefs starting with http are absolute, others are relative to docs/.

cards.name: Spectral Risk Parity
cards.detail: ADIA Lab mapping · name mode, N≥100 · 65m OOS · n_trials=4
cards.verdict: Lost to the Ledoit–Wolf MinVar null on Sharpe and on the risk path; sleeve cut last on Sharpe.

measured.label: Cash-null audit (Quant, 2026-09-26)
measured.text: Its LW MinVar null was about half cash-like ETFs; it scores 1.60 at rf=0 but −0.25 in excess of BIL. Spectral RP still trails ERC and EW in excess of BIL, so the FAIL stands.

cards.verdict: Dual-regime eligibility overlay worse than unconditional ERC on Sharpe, MaxDD and stress months.

cards.name: #13 Vol-cond-factor-corr (VCFC)
cards.detail: Book-2 VT × corr/vol gate · 21 sleeves · 12 trials · 5 bps · best trial L21/C12/g0.5 (~70m)
cards.verdict: No trial beats the unconditional Book-2 VT null on Sharpe; every NW t vs Book-2 negative — milder MaxDD is risk compression only.
cards.nw_t: all 12 trials negative NW t (−1.43 to −3.10)

cards.name: #4 Forecast-tangency MED (FT-MED)
cards.detail: Alexander & Scherer 2023 · category sleeves · 291m OOS · 1 trial · 5 bps
cards.verdict: Primary trial Sharpe below every binding null (EW, LW MinVar, ERC); MaxDD −58.0% worse than EW; turnover 403.8%/yr.
cards.nw_t: NW t vs EW +0.12, not significant; +1.41 vs LW MinVar; +0.85 vs ERC

measured.label: Cash-null audit (Quant, 2026-09-26)
measured.text: In excess of BIL the method still trails EW, ERC and LW MVO; the FAIL doesn't depend on the low-vol LW MinVar null.

cards.name: #3 Regime-resilient ERC (RR-ERC)
cards.detail: Ielpo et al. 2026 / LOIM · category sleeves · 280m OOS · 2 trials (Path A stress overlay, Path B LOIM parity) · 5 bps
cards.verdict: FAIL rests on Path B: NW t +0.14 vs uncond ERC (not significant) and Sharpe 0.869 vs LW MinVar 0.944 (legacy rf = 0; in excess of BIL 0.665 vs 0.642). Path A was degenerate (identical to uncond ERC).
cards.nw_t: Path A degenerate: overlay fell back to uncond ERC at every rebalance; NW t undefined (still counts toward trial_count 2). Path B: +0.14 vs uncond ERC

measured.label: Cash-null audit (Quant, 2026-09-26)
measured.text: LW MinVar outranks Path B at rf=0 but not in excess of BIL; the FAIL rests on Path B vs uncond ERC and stands.

cards.name: Unconditional Book-2 VT
cards.detail: Option A vol-target, no skew gate · registry vol_target_option_a_uncond (enabled:false) · 68m OOS
cards.verdict: Not live and not a FAIL: the null the live #6 VT × gate-first skew overlay was measured against — kept for audit.
cards.archived_via: PR #29 merged; demoted from live to audit null

measured.label: #6 skew overlay measured against it
measured.text: 0.966 excess of BIL (legacy rf = 0: 1.280) / −10.1%, NW t −0.80. Cash-null audit (Quant, 2026-09-26): About 40% of the rf=0 Sharpe gap was cash carry. In excess of BIL it is 0.97 vs 0.84 and the drawdown cut is unchanged, so the PASS as a risk overlay stands.
